name: Romania
famous_for: Transylvanian Bran Castle (associated with Dracula), painted monasteries of Bucovina, Transfăgărășan alpine highway, and Danube Delta.
tourists: Over 13.6M visitors; famous for Peleș Castle, medieval Sighișoara (birthplace of Vlad the Impaler), and Palace of the Parliament.
must_know: The Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest is the heaviest administrative building on Earth, constructed with 700,000 tonnes of steel.
fun_fact: Top Gear dubbed Romania's winding Transfăgărășan highway through the Carpathian Mountains as 'the best driving road in the world'.
